meta.name: ee
meta.description: Working pattern for enterprise-edition features in Grida — the commercial/hosted concerns (entitlement, BYOD, billing) on top of the OSS core. Anchor for the `GRIDA-EE: <surface>` grep marker, `(ee)` route group, `*-hosted` package suffix, and namespaced `grida_*` schema. Use when adding or touching an EE-only feature, or deciding whether a feature is EE territory. Surface skills (`ee-billing`) are siblings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断功能是否属于企业版边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Grida 项目中区分开源与企业版功能
copy.tagline_en: Determine if a feature belongs to enterprise edition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on Grida and need to separate OSS from EE features

howto.what: 当处理 Grida 企业版功能时，Claude 会遵循 EE 边界规则：标记文件、放置代码到 EE 专属位置、确保依赖方向为 EE→OSS，并在涉及安全时优先执行安全审查。
howto.when: 当添加或修改 Grida 中仅企业版才有的功能（如组织权限、自定义域名、计费）时触发。也用于判断某个功能是否属于 EE 范畴。

say.text: 帮我标记这个计费模块为 GRIDA-EE: billing。
say.note: Claude 会在文件头部添加 GRIDA-EE 标记。

say.text: 这个自定义域名功能应该放在哪个目录？

howto.what_en: When working on Grida enterprise-edition features, Claude follows EE boundary rules: tag files with GRIDA-EE markers, place code in EE-named locations, ensure dependency direction is EE→OSS, and run security review first when security is involved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when adding or modifying a feature that exists only for the enterprise edition (e.g., org entitlement, custom domains, billing). Also used when deciding whether a feature is EE territory.

say_en.text: Tag this billing module as GRIDA-EE: billing.
say_en.note: Claude adds the GRIDA-EE marker to the file header.

say_en.text: Where should I put this custom domain feature?
say_en.note: Claude suggests an EE-named location like (ee) route group or *-hosted package.
